answer: Re-attestations are stored in terrace and dawn lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 6 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the whisper graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1417 impostors cost 444 times the honest price and take 7 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
